author: Qwen
description:
RecreationBench
	

GitHub · Website · Leaderboard · Report ↗
RecreationBench is a benchmark of 250 application-recreation tasks across Ubuntu, macOS, Windows, Android, and Web. It is the held-out evaluation suite of RecreationWorld, a framework for scalable and verifiable environments for hybrid computer-use agents.
Given a high-level recreation request and interactive access to a running reference application, an agent explores its behavior, implements a new application, and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Qwen/RecreationBench.
